text: Artificial intelligence is reshaping the world of creativity. Today, AI can paint stunning pictures, compose music, and even write stories. Some people worry that machines will replace human artists, but many experts see this differently. AI works by learning from millions of examples created by humans, so it often imitates rather than invents. True creativity involves emotions, personal experiences, and unexpected leaps of imagination—things machines lack. Instead of replacing us, AI acts as a helpful tool, offering new ideas or saving time. The best results appear when humans and AI collaborate, blending machine efficiency with human feeling. In the end, creativity remains deeply human.
